syllabus_topics: Solving ax + b = c and multi-step linear equations
Variables on both sides of the equation

Rearranging literal equations and formulas (solving for one variable in terms of others)

syllabus_topics: Slope-intercept form y = mx + b; slope and intercepts
Standard form Ax + By = C; point-slope form
Finding the equation of a line from two points or a graph
Parallel and perpendicular lines

syllabus_topics: Function notation f(x) and evaluating linear functions
Interpreting slope as rate of change and intercept as initial value
Constructing linear functions from tables, graphs, and descriptions
skills.title: Linear functions

syllabus_topics: Solving by substitution
Solving by elimination (including multiplying to align coefficients)
Solving graphically; interpreting the intersection point
Systems with no solution (parallel lines) and infinitely many solutions (same line)
skills.title: Systems of two linear equations in two variables

syllabus_topics: Solving one-variable inequalities; flipping the sign when multiplying/dividing by a negative
Compound inequalities
Graphing two-variable inequalities; shading the solution region

Fixed-plus-variable cost models (e.g., y = rate·x + starting fee)
Integer, age, money, and geometry word problems solved with linear equations
